t: You're looking at a sculpture of Saint Thomas Becket on Cheapside. Becket was an English cleric and statesman who served as Lord Chancellor from 1155 to 1162, and then as Archbishop of Canterbury. He is known for his conflict with King Henry II over the rights and privileges of the Church, and he was murdered by followers of the king. The Catholic Church and the Anglican Communion both venerate him as a saint and martyr.
